verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's docs have a dedicated page stating you can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema, alongside a Postman collection, which directly delivers a machine-readable API spec. The probe's 404s on guessed standard paths (/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) don't contradict the documented download; they only show the spec isn't at a conventional auto-discoverable URL. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the schema actually downloads and is complete, a stable discoverable spec URL for agents, and independent corroboration.
